title: Green pens
slide_intent: Reduce identity to elements that survive on a narrow object, because small merchandise offers little room for explanation.
strategic_value: Green pen bodies and contrasting black marks can make a routine tool recognizable as Channel 4 merchandise.
demonstration: Two upright green pens carry black 4 marks on their lighter caps, photographed on a gray surface with a long shadow.
practical_value: Test whether a mark and material color are sufficient for identifying a small cylindrical object.

content_islands.name: Branded objects
content_islands.spec: Place two pens together with the 4 marks facing the viewer near their upper ends.

content_islands.name: Material and light
content_islands.spec: Retain the cap/body color distinction and strong side shadow to show how the identity reads on the physical objects.
